scientific_limitations: Two equally sized patches; constant exchange; symmetric Gaussian thermal performance; fixed climate and linear low-density growth only.
Does not establish absolute persistence, nonlinear equilibrium abundance, stochastic environmental behavior, calibrated habitat restoration, or empirical predictive accuracy.
Strict comparison in extremely poor climates can be quantitatively small in absolute growth units.
title: A unique warming-mismatch threshold for the value of thermal refugia under symmetric dispersal
